original.P22_dev_result: 0/3 masked PPO target FAIL; 0/3 unmasked calibration threshold; strongest finite-difference achieved 200; preserved

question: Does deterministic, past-only reconstruction of velocity from previously executed public observations let the unchanged token-free 489-parameter GRU learn a better factual reward-only CartPole controller, compared with same-budget raw masked histories, deliberately wrong-signed reconstructed velocities, wrong action-credit and unmasked upper-bound calibration?
null: Past-derived velocity does not reach 150 mean reward on each new initialization; fails to gain >=25 against raw masked history or >=15 against wrong-signed feature, or unmasked calibration also fails and prevents attribution solely to missing velocities.

models.architecture: Original unchanged P18/P20 489-param HistoryGRU, eight 6-value rows; no tokens and no transformer

views.name: masked_raw
views.description: All velocity columns [1,3] zero throughout chronological 8-history

views.name: reconstructed_from_past
views.description: Per historical row, reconstruct cart and pole velocity as (position_now - previous position)/0.02 using ONLY factual previous observations in current episode. If prior row unavailable, set both 0; no engine internal state or future observation.

views.name: inverted_reconstructed_velocity
views.description: Same exact past-derived finite differences with sign inverted for both estimated velocity columns. Preserve scale/distribution and computation but corrupt directional meaning.

views.name: unmasked_full_4d
views.description: Real public current sensors, diagnostic calibration only

views.name: reconstructed_wrong_reward_credit
views.description: Past-derived finite differences, true reward-to-go critic, actor advantages shifted 32 steps and one environment.

train.reset_rule: Original env slot j reset seed 86000+1000*j+completed_episode_count; identical planned reset rule per arm but diverging real on-policy trajectories

interpretation.if_reconstruction_passes_and_unmasked_ca: Supports a state-feature extraction bottleneck on public DEV only, not novel cognitive generality
interpretation.if_reconstruction_fails_and_unmasked_cal: Reward-only PPO or exploration/credit remains primary confound; do not blame history alone
interpretation.if_reconstruction_and_unmasked_pass_but_: Supports reconstructability as a candidate bottleneck; stronger matched compute controls still required
